method: AI retrieves package meaning only. Humans verify package, reported cumulative percentage and date. Latest approved date per package wins; contradictory same-day percentages block apply. No percentages are added. PV/EV round to cents per package. Unassessed packages block ratios, variance and forecast. EAC = BAC × AC / EV assumes remaining cost efficiency stays unchanged; not a prediction or financial certification.
